description:
Closes #1777 

Changes to mcpgateway/middleware/http_auth_middleware.py

1. PRE hook optimization (lines 97-140): The PRE hook payload is now only created and invoked when has_pre is True:
if has_pre:
    try:
        pre_result, context_table = await self.plugin_manager.invoke_hook(...)
2. POST hook optimization (lines 145-178): The POST hook payload is now only created and invoked when has_post is True:
if has_post:
    try:
        post_result, _ = await self.plugin_manager.invoke_hook(...)
3. context_table initialization (line 95): Added explicit initialization to ensure context_table is always defined before use:
context_table = None

New Tests in tests/unit/mcpgateway/middleware/test_http_auth_headers.py

Added two new test classes:

1. TestHasHooksForOptimization (6 tests):
  - test_no_hooks_invoked_when_neither_registered
  - test_only_pre_hook_invoked_when_only_pre_registered
  - test_only_post_hook_invoked_when_only_post_registered
  - test_both_hooks_invoked_when_both_registered
  - test_context_table_initialized_when_only_post_registered
  - test_context_table_passed_from_pre_to_post
2. TestHasHooksForPerformance (3 tests):
  - test_invoke_hook_not_called_for_pre_when_not_registered
  - test_invoke_hook_not_called_for_post_when_not_registered
  - test_invoke_hook_not_called_at_all_when_none_registered

Performance Improvement

Before this change, if only POST hooks were registered:
- PRE payload was still created
- invoke_hook was still called for PRE (returning empty result)

After this change:
- Each hook type is guarded individually
- Payloads are only created when the corresponding hook type has registered plugins
- No unnecessary function calls for unregistered hook types
